fields.summary: Form focus for selectize field not working
fields.description:
Configure a selectize enabled form field, e.g. MaterialCategory.xml in hex to have focus as described here. Open the form.

Expected behavior: Form on load should have selectize field enabled.
Actual behavior: Selectize field is not enabled.

Dev Notes:
Probably need to add focus() method in heliumselect.js and use Selectize api to focus. Consider adjust height widgets.
